title: Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses Bithumb said a follow-up review found its October breach exposed more people and data, including passports and wallet addresses, and lasted about 15 days. This post Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
